integrity: The result follows from exact published EML formulas and analytic tail expansion. Numerical checks replay the exact formulas only as consistency tests.
scientific_limitations: Existence but not uniqueness of an interior maximum is proved for alpha at least one.
The full turning-point structure for alpha below one is not classified.
The asymptotic theorem does not provide the smallest finite threshold for eventual decrease.
title: Every exponentiated modified Lindley hazard eventually decreases to its limit from above
